chunks: Al-Saffar narrated from al-Husayn ibn Musa, from Ghiyath, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Ja'far عليه السلام, that 'Ali عليه السلام used to say:
Whoever has intercourse with a woman before she has completed nine years, and he causes injury through harshness, is liable.

key_terms.فَأَعْنَفَ: then he acted harshly and caused injury

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if intercourse causes injury before the girl has completed nine years of age?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning liability for harm caused through intercourse before the woman has completed nine years of age. It establishes financial responsibility where injury results from such harsh conduct.
